Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		catalog: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isCatalogExist: Boolean = catalog.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(catalog) = false
	postcondition:
		if isCatalogExist 
		then let newCatalog: ProductCatalog in
		newCatalog.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newCatalog) and
		newCatalog.Id = id and
		newCatalog.Name = name and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
